## ⚠️ Setup required

Before activating this workflow:
1. Replace the Slack channel ID in **7. Slack — Notify Team** (currently a placeholder: `REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_SLACK_CHANNEL_ID`).
2. Configure your own Gmail, OpenAI, Google Sheets, and Slack credentials.
3. Update the Google Sheet ID in **6. Google Sheets — Log** to point at your own tracker.
